Working notes (REQ-2406–2415)

Task: assign requests to desk A (standard queue), B (priority desk), or C (regional office).

Observed rules:
- C was accepted only for east-region large requests: large claim east (REQ-2413), large invoice east (REQ-2414).
- C was rejected for: large refund south, small shipment north, small claim east, large invoice north, large shipment north. So C is not general regional routing; likely valid only when region=east AND size=large.
- B was rejected for: large claim south, large refund east, large claim east. No accepted B yet. Avoid B unless new evidence appears.
- A has not been tried/confirmed. If C/B are invalid, A may be the default fallback, but this is unverified.

Useful cues:
- Region + size matter more than request type or phrases like “second attempt,” “client asking twice,” or “came in through regional office.”
- East + large is the only confirmed C case so far.
- Small item (even east) rejected C.
- North large rejected C.

Data caution:
- Some rejected records say “option C is not valid” even when B was attempted. Trust the attempted option and accepted/rejected outcome over the explanatory text.

Next decision policy:
- For east + large: prefer C (confirmed for claim/invoice; test shipment/refund).
- For all other combinations: do not use C. Do not use B without new positive evidence; consider A as likely fallback if allowed.
- Keep tracking whether C applies to east large shipment/refund, and whether B ever succeeds.

Working notes (REQ-2406–2425)

Task: assign to A standard, B priority, C regional.

Confirmed:
- C accepted only for east+large: claim/invoice (2413/14). C rejected for small east, north large invoice/shipment, north small shipment, south large refund. Use C only for east+large; test refund/shipment.
- A accepted: south+small claim (2418), north+large refund (2424), north+large shipment (2425). A is NOT a general fallback.
- A rejected: south large shipment/claim (2416/2422), east small shipment/refund/invoice (2417/2421/2423), south small shipment (2419), north small claim (2420). Avoid A for those.
- B still has no accepted case. Rejected: large claim south, large refund east, large claim east. Keep avoiding B unless new positive evidence appears.

Cues:
- Region+size+type matter more than urgency, “second attempt,” or regional-office phrasing.
- Rejection text may name a different option (e.g., an A attempt says “C invalid” or “B invalid”). Trust attempted option and accepted/rejected outcome over explanatory text.

Next policy:
- east+large: prefer C (confirmed claim/invoice; test refund/shipment).
- north+large: prefer A (confirmed refund/shipment; test invoice/claim).
- south+small: A confirmed only for claim; other types unknown.
- Other combos: do not use A by default; B untrusted; C only east+large. If forced, test B or mark unknown, but avoid known A/C/B rejections.

Track:
- C for east large refund/shipment.
- A for north large invoice/claim.
- Whether B ever succeeds.
- South large claim: A/B rejected, C unknown.
- East small claim/refund: C or A/B rejected.

Working notes (REQ-2406–2435)

Task: assign A standard, B priority, C regional.

Confirmed:
- C only east+large: accepted claim/invoice (2413/14). C rejected small east, north large invoice/shipment, north small shipment, south large refund. Test east large refund/shipment.
- A accepted: north large refund/shipment/invoice (2424/25/30). A rejected: north large claim (2429/32), south large shipment/claim (2416/2422), east small shipment/refund/invoice (2417/21/23), south small shipment (2419), north small claim (2420), south small claim now (2433). So A is not a general fallback; use only north large non-claim.
- B accepted: east small invoice (2427), east small shipment (2428/31), north small invoice (2434). B rejected: large claim south, large refund east, large claim east. So B works for small invoice/shipment in east/north; avoid B for large claim/refund.
- D attempts (2426/2435) invalid/unhelpful; ignore D.

Cues:
- Region+size+type matter more than urgency, “second attempt,” or office phrasing.
- Rejection text may name another option (e.g. A attempt says “B/D invalid”). Trust attempted option outcome over explanatory text, but note inconsistencies.

Next policy:
- east+large: prefer C (claim/invoice); test refund/shipment.
- north+large: A for refund/shipment/invoice; A rejected for claim—test B/C.
- east/north small invoice/shipment: prefer B.
- south small: A rejected for claim (2433); B/C unknown—test.
- Other: avoid known A/B/C rejections; do not default A; C only east+large.

Track:
- C east large refund/shipment.
- north large claim: A rejected; test B/C.
- south small claim/shipment/invoice.
- B for south small and east small claim/refund.
- Whether D ever valid (likely no).

Working notes (REQ-2406–2445)

Task: assign A standard, B priority, C regional.

Confirmed:
- C: east+large claim/invoice accepted (2413/14, 2437/42). C rejected east large shipment (2441); also rejected north large invoice/shipment, south large refund, small east/north. Test east large refund.
- A: accepted north large refund/invoice (2424/30). Rejected north large claim; now north large shipment rejected (2444), conflicting with earlier 2425—treat A for north large shipment as uncertain. A is not a general fallback; rejected south large claim/shipment, east small, north/south small claims, etc.
- B: accepted east small invoice/shipment (2427/28/31/2440), north small invoice (2434), south small claim (2439). Rejected north small refund (2436), south small invoice/shipment (2438/2443), large claim/refund. So B works for small invoice/shipment in east/north and south small claim only.
- D invalid (2426/2435/2445); ignore.

Cues:
- Region+size+type dominate; urgency, phrasing, “second attempt” do not.
- Rejection text may name another invalid option; trust attempted-option outcome but flag conflicts.

Next policy:
- east+large: C for claim/invoice; shipment C rejected—test A/B; refund test C first.
- north+large: A for refund/invoice; claim/shipment uncertain—test B/C, re-check A conflict.
- east/north small invoice/shipment: B.
- south small claim: B. South small invoice/shipment: B rejected; test A/C.
- south large: A/B rejected claim; test C/invoice, avoid B claim.
- Do not default A; C only east+large except test refund.

Track:
- north large shipment conflict.
- east large refund/shipment.
- south small invoice/shipment.
- south large invoice.
- D validity (likely no).

Working notes (REQ-2406–2455)

Task: assign A standard, B priority, C regional.

Confirmed/updated:
- B: east small invoice/shipment (incl 2446); north small invoice; south small claim (2452). Rejected north small refund; south small invoice/shipment; large claim/refund.
- A: north large refund/invoice; north small refund accepted (2454). Rejected north large claim; south large claim/shipment; south small invoice (2448); east/north/south small claims mostly.
- C: east large claim now conflicted: accepted 2450, rejected 2455. East large invoice rejected 2447, contradicting earlier C invoice. East large refund C rejected (2451). South large invoice C rejected (2449). North large claim C rejected (2453).
- D invalid (2426/2435/2445); ignore.

Cues:
- Region+size+type dominate; urgency/phrasing/“second attempt” do not.
- Rejection text may name another invalid option; trust attempted-option outcome but flag conflicts.

Next policy:
- east small invoice/shipment: B.
- east large: claim uncertain (C conflict); invoice/refund avoid C, test A/B; shipment test A/B.
- north large: A for refund/invoice; claim test B (A/C rejected); shipment uncertain.
- north small: invoice B; refund A.
- south small claim: B. South small invoice: A/B rejected, C likely invalid—test cautiously. South small shipment: B rejected; test A/C.
- south large: A/B rejected claim; C rejected invoice; avoid B claim, test A/C for invoice/refund.
- Do not default A; C only east+large but now conflicted.

Track:
- east large claim C conflict (2450 vs 2455).
- east large invoice/refund/shipment.
- north large shipment/claim.
- south small invoice/shipment.
- south large invoice/refund.
- D validity (likely no).

Working notes (REQ-2406–2459)

Task: assign A standard, B priority, C regional.

Confirmed:
- B: east small invoice/shipment; north small invoice; south small claim.
- A: north large refund/invoice; north small refund; east small refund (2456); east large invoice (2457).
- C: east large claim conflicted: accepted 2450, rejected 2455. Other large C rejected: east invoice 2447/2457, east refund 2451, south invoice 2449, north claim 2453, south claim 2459. D invalid (2426/2435/2445/2459).

Rejected/avoid:
- north small refund; south small invoice/shipment.
- north large claim A/C; south large claim A/B/C; south large invoice C.
- east large refund C; east large invoice C; north large shipment B (2458).

Cues:
- Region+size+type dominate; urgency/phrasing/second attempt irrelevant.
- Rejection text may name another invalid option; trust attempted-option outcome; flag conflicts.

Next policy:
- east small invoice/shipment B; east small refund A.
- east large: invoice A; claim C uncertain; refund avoid C, test A/B; shipment test A/B.
- north large: refund/invoice A; claim test B? A/C rejected; shipment B rejected, test A/C.
- north small: invoice B; refund A.
- south small claim B. South small invoice/shipment: B rejected; test A/C cautiously.
- south large: claim A/B/C invalid; invoice C rejected, test A; refund test A/C.
- Do not default A; C only east+large, conflicted.

Track:
- east large claim C conflict (2450 vs 2455).
- east large refund/shipment.
- north large shipment/claim.
- south small invoice/shipment.
- south large invoice/refund.
- D invalid.
